lines.text: Many learners say: I don't like coffee, too.
Better: I don't like coffee, either.
Either! I don't like tea, either.

native.tip: 否定のあとの「〜も」は either。too は使いません。
native.caption: “I don't like coffee, too.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語は「も」だけなので、否定でも too を使いがちです。“I don't like coffee, either.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“either”。“I don't like coffee, either.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: After not, say either, not too.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I don't like coffee, too.” 😅 Japanese uses one word も for both, but English changes too to either after not. The natural way is “I don't like coffee, either.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
